field_form_rules: Show no more than five mechanism-specific questions before an adaptive branch is justified.
Require structured reason codes but preserve a short verbatim note.
Allow unknown, declined and not-applicable values.
Field-only information never leaks backward into the original pre-visit feature snapshot.
Record question version, representative, timestamp and recommendation ID.
